title: Key Moments From the Georgia Senate Debate Beween Ossoff and Collins
summary: Senator Jon Ossoff, a Democrat, called his Republican opponent, Representative Mike Collins, a bigot. Mr. Collins called the incumbent a radical “trust-fund kid.”
